messages:
Priya (PM): Quick check-in: propose Optimize Toolkit v1 launch plan: 1) Read-only recommendations API (batching/caching/quant hints) 2) Daily eval-triggered alerts (configurable thresholds) 3) Minimal admin UI (mute, preview, revert). Goal: pilot with two customers in 7 weeks.

Evan (Eng): For rollout we should canary at tenant level: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with automated latency & error gates. Also require perf harness matching Notesly traffic.

Rita (Data): Alert metrics: top-1/top-3 concordance, perplexity delta, and effective token-savings. Default thresholds but tenant override. Example: "concordance < 0.9 over 72h" -> warn.

Noah (Runtime): Runtime constraints: quant support varies by model. Add `quality_tier` param (`high|medium|low`) and a `safe_mode` opt-in to avoid model swaps. Telemetry tags: rec_source, suggested_quant, cache_hit, est_tokens_saved.

Kai (Design): Admin UX: show preview diff of recent outputs, quick mute/unmute for alerts, and an estimated savings badge. Will mock a compact panel for routes dashboard.

ci-bot: Staging deploy scheduled at 1746667000 :rocket:

Priya (PM): Launch criteria: two pilots onboarded, telemetry emitted, perf within 1.2x p95 baseline, docs + runbook published. Action items: Evan -> perf plan & harness (Thu). Noah -> telemetry contract + fallback chain (Mon). Rita -> threshold presets + sample datasets (Fri). Kai -> admin mock (Wed). I'll handle pilot invites and legal.

Evan (Eng): Acknowledged, will start load profiles today.

Noah (Runtime): Will prototype fallback and add `quality_tier` to API draft.

Rita (Data): I'll assemble pilot eval sets and suggest thresholds by EOW.
